purpose: Evidence-only harvest of non-N0TE repositories for mechanisms N0TE2 may reuse without merging project identity, importing stale authority, or directly copying legacy source.

findings.mechanism: bounded recent-session context loaded from local logs
findings.reason: N0TE2 already owns stronger scoped Session, Memory, Resume, Context and provenance semantics. Do not create a second log-memory substrate.

findings.mechanism: pre-egress redaction of obvious private values
findings.reason: N0TE2 already has explicit egress, provenance, private-data destination/purpose approval and trust-boundary semantics. Regex scrubbing is not sufficient authority.
N0TE2 authority/approval/revalidation/transaction contracts supersede the coarse gate.

findings.mechanism: hard-reset path after suspicious command generation
findings.reason: N0TE2 recovery, worker isolation, failure visibility and safe mutation contracts are more granular and should remain canonical.

findings.mechanism: persist a local session artifact and mirror it to Google Drive
findings.reason: The useful idea is durable local/cloud continuity, not Zenith's credential-file uploader. N0TE2 PR #63 already defines shared durable brain, receipts, revision/conflict checks and GitHub/Drive reconciliation. Runtime product cloud backup/sync remains held.

findings.mechanism: service-account credentials.json plus direct Drive upload of session JSON
findings.reason: Do not copy credentials, broad session dumps, or direct cloud mutation into N0TE2. Connected execution must remain minimum-needed, authority-gated, receipt-backed and conflict-safe.
Offensive-target execution is not a N0TE product capability and must not contaminate Artist Headquarters or its control plane. Generic executor-envelope ideas are already represented independently.

findings.mechanism: single health snapshot combining runtime prerequisites, install artifacts, local endpoints, context/library state, transactions/checkpoints and Remote Script diagnostics
findings.reason: The diagnostic shape is useful evidence for DAW-01/support/packaging acceptance, but N0TE2 must re-express it through current host-observation, support, platform and executor-evidence boundaries rather than restore an Ableton-specific product center.

findings.mechanism: transactional install/update/uninstall, rollback, path confinement, health handshake and recovery of displaced files
findings.reason: These behaviors remain relevant to APP/PLATFORM/DAW acceptance. They do not authorize direct legacy transplant and must be independently verified per current platform/host scope.

findings.mechanism: fail-closed offline defaults, local loopback allowance, no automatic paid fallback and provider-specific transport constraints
findings.reason: N0TE2 already represents network/offline, egress, provider authority and local/cloud separation. Retain the legacy tests as regression ideas, not a parallel policy source.

findings.mechanism: explicit separation between mocked/unit validation and real Ableton/audio/plugin/customer-machine acceptance
findings.reason: This strengthens N0TE2's existing evidence-spine rule that authored tests and build health cannot masquerade as real host, consumer, audio or value acceptance.

sources.reason: The current GitHub connector exposes the ZIP as binary/base64 but cannot decode the full blob through its UTF-8 blob path. No implementation is admitted from an incompletely inspected archive. Preserve the exact blob identity so a future binary-capable executor can inspect it once without rediscovery.

net_new_value_for_n0te2.value: Make external-repository archaeology a durable, provenance-bound harvest record so useful mechanisms are not repeatedly rediscovered and rejected duplicates stay rejected.
Treat Drive brain continuity as conflict-safe governance/context reconciliation across repository, Product DB and canonical Drive context, not as raw session mirroring or product cloud backup/sync.
Retain AbletonAI's composite health and transactional lifecycle evidence for later DAW/platform/support acceptance without re-centering N0TE on Ableton.

next_binary_wake_condition: A binary-capable authorized GitHub/local executor becomes available to inspect Music/AI.zip at blob 45c36c89cd8a818975b098bb6bc65074217bde68. Do not repeatedly retry unchanged connector limitations.
sync_rule: Any material change to this harvest's canonical disposition must be reconciled into N0TE_PRODUCT_DB and relevant Drive context in the same operating cycle.
